_meta.description: Cross-engine ODE timing on the six largest curated SBML BioModels carrying a real figure-tied horizon (the SBML counterpart to Table S3). Cold = one-time build + first solve; warm = median of subsequent solves. SBML engines (RoadRunner/AMICI/COPASI) and BNGsim ingest the curated SBML natively; run_network integrates a .net derived offline via bngsim.sbml_to_net (model-prep, not charged; recorded in net_conversion).
_meta.horizon_note: integration span = [SED-ML initialTime, outputEndTime] so pre-window events fire; output_start = SED-ML outputStartTime (plotted window).
